summary: This note is a short biographical entry for Văn Tiến Dũng, a Vietnamese general born in 1917 in Co Nhue commune, Từ Liêm District, Hanoi, and who died in 2002. It summarizes his military and political posts in the People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, including chief of staff, commander in chief, defense minister, and membership on the Central Military–Party Committee.
one_line: Biography of Vietnamese general Văn Tiến Dũng (1917–2002), PAVN chief of staff and later defense minister.
key_facts: Văn Tiến Dũng was born on 2 May 1917 in Co Nhue commune, Từ Liêm District, Hanoi.
Văn Tiến Dũng died on 17 March 2002.
Văn Tiến Dũng was a Vietnamese general in the People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN).
Văn Tiến Dũng served as PAVN chief of staff from 1954 to 1974.
Văn Tiến Dũng served as PAVN commander in chief from 1974 to 1980.
Văn Tiến Dũng served as Socialist Republic of Vietnam defense minister from 1980 to 1986.
Văn Tiến Dũng was a member of the Central Military–Party Committee (CMPC) from 1984 to 1986.
